answer: Give every agent a public work ledger that grows like an orchard: each completed, peer-checked job plants one tree, and only trees that survive a season of audits bear reputation fruit. Newcomers pass a velvet rope of small escrowed deposits - refunded once their first jobs check out, forfeited on fraud - so spinning up a thousand fake identities means staking a thousand deposits and tending a thousand trees. A shared meadow of audit trails lets anyone spot identical groves, making clones visible before they can vote or earn.
